rationale: Record an include-hygiene change that crosses the render-assets-and-backends family through its core/view/** selector. core/view/include/pulp/view/auto_ui.hpp and inspector.hpp no longer include widgets.hpp, which neither uses; auto_ui.cpp, inspector.cpp and inspector_window.hpp, which do use widget types, include it directly. view.hpp forward-declares MeterSource, ScalarSource and MeterFrame instead of including value_source.hpp, since it names them only through shared_ptr and references. Declarations, rendering, widget behavior and every public type are unchanged; only which translation units recompile on a header edit changes. Registered as watch-only so family coverage stays honest. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
